item.title: Houston favorite called the most outrageous restaurant in the US, Yelp says
item.description: Yelp has released a list of the most outrageous restaurants in the US, featuring unique dining experiences such as an underwater restaurant, a chocolate-themed restaurant and a Broadway-themed restaurant.

item.title: Incumbent KP George finishes last in Fort Bend County Judge GOP primary
item.description: Voters in Fort Bend County could be selecting a new county judge in Tuesday’s primary elections.

item.title: Former Houston Mayor Annise Parker leads Dem primary for county judge
item.description: Harris County voters went to the polls on Tuesday to choose nominees in the race for county judge.

item.title: Abbott projected as GOP nominee for governor; set to face Hinojosa in November
item.description: Incumbent Gov. Greg Abbott is set for a run at a fourth term after winning the GOP nomination on Tuesday, according to Associated Press Projections. On the Democratic side, Texas Rep. Gina Hinojosa, D-Austin, is the projected winner.

item.title: Crockett v. Talarico: Texas Democrats battle for a chance at flipping a U.S. Senate seat
item.description: Former colleagues in the Texas House of Representatives face off Tuesday night to see who will represent the Democratic Party in the race for the U.S. Senate. A Democratic candidate has not won a statewide election in Texas in three decades.

item.title: Why Tuesday is likely the first of two primaries for the Texas Republican Senate race
item.description: The 2026 U.S. Senate race in Texas is shaping up to be a highly contested election between Republican Sen. John Cornyn, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, and U.S. Rep. Wesley Hunt, with the potential for a runoff between the top two candidates.

item.title: Texas Supreme Court orders Dallas County to 'separate' votes cast during extended voting
